item.title: Food waste bins on pathway, 7th August
item.description:
Over the last few weeks there has been food waste bins on the public pathway, I fail to see why these bins need to be on the pathway as not only are they unsightly, encourage rubbish dumping and block the pathway, if they are associated with the church, they have a carpark that already has waste storage in it, and across the road the building has a storage waste room.

item.title: Constant flytipping in Durfey Place, 7th August
item.description:
Flytipping in Durfey Place remains a constant issue. I have already raised this within several complaints. It is now happening almost every day, and it continues to have a real impact on residents. Ms Sophia Opoku-Addo, Resident Services Officer for this area, never replied to any emails about the issue and the working group set up by her predecessor. This is simply unacceptable.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Durfey Place, Camberwell, Greater London
